meaning: The machine has gone into fault; the machine has thermally tripped.
remedy: Allow the machine to cool. There is no circuit breaker to reset; the machine resumes normal operation automatically once remedied.

meaning: The machine has gone into fault; the voltage input is below the specified limit.
remedy: Inspect input voltage and ensure it is within machine limits. Consult operator manual for machine specifications.

meaning: The machine has gone into fault; the voltage input is higher than the specified limit.
remedy: Inspect input voltage and ensure it is within machine limits. Consult operator manual for machine specifications.
